# Gadget360.ng

> Authentic gadgets in Lagos, Nigeria — smartphones, laptops, gaming consoles and accessories. Buy, sell and swap with warranty. WhatsApp +234 810 841 8727.

Gadget360.ng is a Lagos-based gadget retailer with two physical stores (Ikeja and Computer Village). We sell new and UK-used phones, laptops, PlayStation and Xbox consoles, audio gear and accessories, with warranty and Lagos-wide delivery. Orders and quotes are handled on WhatsApp.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured products, categories, brand story and customer testimonials.
- [Shop](/shop): Full catalogue with search, category filters and live stock.
- [Contact](/contact): Lagos store addresses, phone numbers, WhatsApp and contact form.

## Categories

- [Smartphones](/shop?category=Smartphones): iPhone, Samsung, Google Pixel and more.
- [Laptops](/shop?category=Laptops): MacBook, Windows ultrabooks and gaming laptops.
- [Apple](/shop?category=Apple): iPad, Apple Watch, AirPods and Apple accessories.
- [Gaming](/shop?category=Gaming): PlayStation 5, Xbox Series and accessories.
- [Audio](/shop?category=Audio): Headphones, earbuds and speakers.
- [Accessories](/shop?category=Accessories): Chargers, cases, cables and storage.
